If tightened: an implementation item filed, or the change merged with oracle review
context: Owner decisions D-O1 and D-O2 (2026-10-08) matched the live gate and said tightening could be its own decision after cutover. Two oracle shadow threads on PR #2751 record the gaps (validator change skipped; bijection self-comparison); the agent rebutted them and left them for the owner to resolve.
description:
The bundle attestations deliberately match the deploy gate they replace. Two accepted gaps remain:

1. **Bijection self-reference.** `corpus_bijection` runs with `--accepted-ref`, `--expect-source` and `--bundles-dir` all at the bundle commit, as `scripts/site_deploy/gates.py:117-131` does. It proves snapshot-to-tree consistency, not that the published bundles were accepted. Comparing against `published-results` instead failed every bundle while a results mirror PR was open.
2. **Validator-only changes.** `validator_parity` runs only when the results-data tree changed. A change to validator code alone is not re-checked against the existing corpus until the next corpus change. `validator_parity.py` compares only bundles that changed in range, so it cannot cover this without a new full-corpus mode.

Decide, with the owner, whether either should be tightened once the site repo is the production writer. Options include a full-corpus parity mode, or a bijection against the accepted corpus that tolerates an open mirror PR.
